notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is missing or incorrect in the Mozio email confirmation specifically for return trip tickets. The create-reservations mapper has explicit return-trip handling (swapping from/to stations) but may not correctly propagate the discount/promo amount for return-trip line items. The sanitized Mozio dispatch mapper reads discount from dispatch.report.price.discount — if that data is absent or zero for return trips, the email confirmation won't display it.

notes: Openspec provided no acceptance criteria (empty array) and only a root-cause analysis note. I built the full AC set from the defect description and the technical files listed. ACs 1–3 cover the core fix and regression for one-way trips and the zero-discount case. AC 4 targets the sanitized dispatch mapper to ensure discount propagation at the data layer. AC 5 addresses the specific return-trip station-swap path in create-reservations mapping. AC 6 covers the multi-segment scenario where both outbound and return have discounts. AC 7 ensures the webhook pipeline preserves discount data end-to-end. AC 8 covers the return-trip modification mapper. AC 9 is an edge case for discount amounts that equal or exceed the trip price.

The discount field exists in SanitizedMozioDispatch and is correctly mapped for one-way trips, but return trip dispatches do not include the promo code discount amount in their report price data.
after.title: [Mozio] - Promo code amount not displayed for Return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmation

notes: Prior openspec pass produced zero acceptance criteria — this pass derives AC from the defect description and code analysis. The root issue is that the promo code discount amount is missing from return-trip dispatches in the Mozio email confirmation. The SanitizedMozioDispatch type already supports an optional discount field, and mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch correctly maps it when present. The defect likely lies upstream in how return-trip dispatches are constructed or how report discounts are applied to return-trip line items — either the discount data is not populated on the return-trip dispatch report, or the return-trip modification mapper strips it.
